correctness.rationale: In characteristic two the cubic is invariant under all-one translation on sum Xi=0; quotient by the all-one vector is the smooth Clebsch cubic (five square derivatives force all coordinates equal, then sum forces zero). Any contained plane must pass through the vertex, since projection otherwise produces a plane in a smooth cubic surface; planes through the vertex correspond to cubic-surface lines. Cayley–Salmon yields 27 geometric lines. The two coprime normal derivative binary quadrics rule out infinitesimal deformations of the cone plane; consequently the finite Fano scheme is reduced and etale over perfect F2. Independent GF4 row-reduced enumeration over 357 lines found 27 contained and 15 Frobenius-fixed; the cubic Picard rank seven and Frob^2=1 on lines imply eigenvalues +1 sixfold/-1 once from 15 F2 points. The cone count is 1+q times the base count, yielding all-extension zeta. The GF4 enumeration alone does not prove 27 geometric lines or zeta for all m.
residual_risks: The tests are finite and do not replace the all-parameter proof.
